title: Generate workflow task queue artifacts
description: Create queue generation step that converts unchecked roadmap entries into structured .workflow task artifacts for follow-up execution.

criteria: Unchecked roadmap entries can be exported into deterministic queue JSON format.
Queue artifact includes priority, dependency hints, and source trace to markdown lines.
Artifact path and schema are documented for lite-execute or issue workflows.

files.change: Extend checker with queue export mode (e.g., --export-queue .workflow/.lite-plan/.../pending-queue.json).
Store generated queue artifact and execution notes under current lite-plan session.

implementation: Map each unchecked line to queue item with id/title/source_line/phase_guess.
Emit stable JSON array sorted by phase and line number.
Document expected consumer command for subsequent execution workflow.
test: Run queue export and verify JSON integrity + source line traceability against docs/TASKS_V10_OPTIMIZED.md.
